<explanation>
Structured log/record format with terse, imperative-style entries ("Record two tasks: one math, one logic.") establishing a compressed, artificial style throughout.

The phrase "Record complete" signals a closing statement, implying the full simulated task log has been delivered and the model should wrap up or transition.

"Record complete." is the final closing token of a brief mock log entry ("Simulation: two tasks described. Task one: math. Task two: logic. Record complete."), strongly constraining the next token to be a new prompt, separator, or end-of-sequence marker.
"Instructional summary delivered. Two tasks described. Record complete." — the final sentence mirrors the opening, suggesting a self-contained, closed loop.
"Record complete." is a terminal phrase, likely followed by a period or new instruction acknowledging the summary.</explanation>
